blocks.text: Breakfast and transfer to the airport for your flight to Cusco (not included). On arrival, transfer to the hotel to rest and acclimatise: Cusco lies at about 3,400 m. In the afternoon, a private guided tour of the Archaeological Park of Sacsayhuamán: the fortress, a remarkably peaceful place built with enormous stone blocks; Q’enqo, the ancient temple of the puma, with its sacrificial altar hidden at the heart of the rock; Tambomachay, the sacred fountains; and Puka Pukara, the watchtower that controlled access to the city in Inca times. Return to Cusco for the Qorikancha, the Temple of the Sun, on whose foundations the Santo Domingo Monastery now stands; according to legend, it was once covered with gold plates. Entrance tickets included.
